stories.title: Nepal's 'miracle' takes them into World Cup Qualifiers
stories.subTitle: World Cricket League Division Two 2018
stories.seoTitle: Nepal's 'miracle' takes them into World Cup Qualifiers
stories.summary: With one wicket in hand, Nepal needed eight off the final over. The first four balls were dots, but Karan KC's six off the fifth ball propelled them to an improbable win against Canada

image.caption: Karan KC is hoisted into the air by his team-mates after rallying Nepal to a miracle win

stories.title: Canada survive Kenjige hat-trick to level series at 1-1
stories.subTitle: Canada v USA, 2017 Auty Cup, King City
stories.seoTitle: Canada survive Nosthush Kenjige hat-trick to level Auty Cup series at 1-1
stories.summary: Losing four wickets in four balls could not shake Canada's confidence as they defeated USA by five wickets thanks to an unbroken 92-run stand between Saad Bin Zafar and Dhanuka Pathirana
stories.byline: Peter Della Penna at King City
